description: Flom aktsomhetsområder - Nesodden is a dataset listed in National Single Information Point of Norway, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Nesodden kommune. Flom aktsomhetsområder basert på lokal 1x1 m terrengmodell fra laserskanning i 2014. Områder mindre enn 0.2 daa er tatt ut. Datasettet viser hvilke arealer som kan være utsatt for flomfare. Coverage: Nesodden kommune. The publisher named on the listing is Nesodden kommune. Its keywords include aktsomhet, Samfunnssikkerhet, Det offentlige kartgrunnlaget, fellesDatakatalog, Local, Nesodden. The listing shows 1 download or service links in TXT. The listing shows 2016-03-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://inspire.ec.europa.eu/metadata-codelist/ConditionsApplyingToAccessAndUse/noConditionsApply). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-nsip-no.
